lead.title: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol delivers half the price, double the token efficiency
lead.summary: Sam Altman announced GPT-5.6 Sol delivers roughly half the price and roughly 2x more token efficiency than Fable for many tasks, positioning it as a major cost-performance breakthrough for production AI workloads. OpenAI's inference team is struggling to keep up with demand.

top_stories.title: OpenAI agentic usage explodes 2.5x in one week
top_stories.summary: OpenAI reported a 2.5x increase in usage of its agentic products (Codex, ChatGPT Work features) over the past week, signaling rapid real-world adoption of AI agents in production workflows.

top_stories.title: Codex reaches 6M users, described as 'IPO altering' for OpenAI
top_stories.summary: Codex hit roughly 6 million active users, growing about 1 million in a single day and overtaking Claude's coding usage. Swyx called it 'IPO altering stuff' for OpenAI, linking to Latent Space analysis.

top_stories.title: DeepSeek reportedly in talks to raise $1.5B at $71B valuation ahead of IPO
top_stories.summary: Chinese LLM developer DeepSeek is in discussions to raise $1.5 billion at roughly a $71 billion valuation, with an IPO targeted for 2027 or earlier. Existing investors include Tencent and the Beijing National AI Industry Investment Fund.

top_stories.title: Chai Discovery raises $400M Series C at $3.8B valuation for AI drug discovery
top_stories.summary: Chai Discovery raised $400 million in Series C funding at a $3.8 billion valuation, led by Index Ventures with Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia Capital, and Dimension. The company builds AI models for molecular prediction and antibody design with partners including Eli Lilly, Pfizer, and Novartis.

items.title: Hourglass reasoning enforces rigorous induction-deduction separation, gains 14 points on ARC-AGI-2
items.summary: Think Through a Bottleneck enforces strict isolation between induction and deduction stages in frozen LLMs, yielding up to 14-point gains on ARC-AGI-2 and nearly doubling Verilog synthesis accuracy on ChipBench.

items.title: Weak-to-strong generalization via direct on-policy distillation boosts Qwen3-1.7B by 10 points on AIME
items.summary: Direct-OPD transfers RL policy shifts from weaker to stronger models using implicit reward signals, boosting Qwen3-1.7B from 48.3% to 58.3% on AIME 2024 in 4 hours on 8 A100 GPUs.

items.title: ABot-N1: A general visual language navigation foundation model with slow-fast architecture
items.summary: ABot-N1 decouples cognition from control using a slow-fast architecture, achieving SOTA urban-scale navigation with POI arrival boosted from 35% to 77.3% and 95.4%/92.9% SR in complex indoor/outdoor scenes.

items.title: ABot-AgentOS: A general robotic agent OS with lifelong multimodal memory and self-evolution
items.summary: ABot-AgentOS provides a deliberative agent layer with Universal Multi-modal Graph Memory and self-evolution, achieving 88.7 on LoCoMo and 60.4 on OpenEQA EM-EQA with failure-driven improvement.

items.title: 4D human-scene reconstruction from low-overlap captures achieves SOTA with +5 dB PSNR gains
items.summary: StudioRecon decouples background and humans using video diffusion densification and deformable Gaussians, achieving SOTA novel view synthesis with +1.5 to +5.0 dB PSNR gains over prior methods.

items.title: GLM-5.2: Zhipu AI releases new open-weights model with IndexShare DSA architecture
items.summary: Zhipu AI released GLM-5.2, a new open-weights model featuring IndexShare in its DSA layers and a stronger Multi-Token Prediction head reusing IndexShare and KVShare techniques. Available on Hugging Face.

items.title: Bonsai 27B: First 27B-class multimodal model to run on a phone, Apache 2.0 license
items.summary: PrismML released Bonsai 27B, based on Qwen3.6, using ternary {-1,0,+1} weights with FP16 scaling (1.71 bits/weight, 5.9 GB). Retains roughly 95% of full-precision performance on reasoning, tool-calling, vision, and agentic tasks with 262K context. A 1-bit variant at 3.9 GB fits iPhones.

items.title: Serving GLM-5.2 NVFP4 with SGLang: 500+ TPS on 8x Blackwell B300
items.summary: LMSYS published optimizations for serving GLM-5.2 on Blackwell hardware, achieving 500+ tokens/s per user at batch size 1. Key wins include 18-34% better single-user interactivity and a new TopK-V2 kernel 2.33x faster at 80K context.

items.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra: Ralph loops for agentic performance with LangChain Deep Agents
items.summary: NVIDIA published a technical blog on Ralph loops — iterative agentic patterns using filesystem as persistent memory — with LangChain Deep Agents Harness for Nemotron 3 Ultra. Tuning the harness rather than the model improves agent benchmarks without fine-tuning.

items.title: NVIDIA Blackwell NVL72 sets new bar for AI infrastructure performance per watt
items.summary: NVIDIA published a detailed analysis showing Blackwell NVL72 delivers the highest performance per watt for AI factories, positioning tokens per watt and cost per token as the key metrics for maximizing AI infrastructure revenue and profit margins.

items.title: New York becomes first US state to impose one-year moratorium on hyperscale data centers
items.summary: New York enacted a one-year statewide moratorium on data centers requiring at least 50 megawatts, citing concerns over electricity prices, water consumption, and pressure on local infrastructure, with more than 12 GW of new loads awaiting grid connection.

items.title: Reflection AI signs over $1B compute deal with Nebius for NVIDIA processors
items.summary: AI startup Reflection AI signed a $1B+ compute agreement with Nebius for access to NVIDIA's newest processors, following a separate $150M/month deal with SpaceX through 2029, highlighting how securing compute capacity has become as critical as model development.

items.title: NVIDIA halves approved Asian buyers for AI chips to curb smuggling to China
items.summary: NVIDIA slashed approved Asian buyers for advanced AI chips by more than half, implementing a stricter whitelist and enhanced compliance reviews including on-site data center visits, targeting entities in Singapore, Malaysia, and Japan suspected of facilitating diversion to China.

items.title: xAI installed 59 natural gas turbines for Colossus 2 without federal air permits
items.summary: Elon Musk's xAI installed 59 natural-gas turbines for its Colossus 2 data center project in Tennessee without obtaining required federal clean-air permits, with predominantly Black communities near the site raising health and environmental justice concerns.

items.title: Pazi — Vibe code your entire business operations with AI agent teams
items.summary: AI team platform from the creator of Pythagora (33K GitHub stars) that assembles agent teams around business ideas to handle websites, outreach, content, and operations autonomously while keeping the user in control.

items.title: Juggler — Open-source GUI coding agent from the creator of JUCE
items.summary: Open-source (AGPLv3) visual workbench for AI coding agents with CRDT-based branching session trees, Miller column navigation, JavaScript plugin system, and multi-client support across desktop, browser, and phone.

items.title: ClawTeams — Goal-driven proactive AI team for e-commerce sellers
items.summary: AI employee platform for e-commerce where users set high-level goals like revenue targets and a coordinated AI team plans, assigns specialist agents, executes, and reports updates via Slack or Discord.

items.title: Credo AI Agent Governor — Governance policies as code for AI agent runtime control
items.summary: Governance tool that installs approved policies as code onto AI agent harnesses for real-time runtime control with allow/block/escalate/advice outcomes and detailed auditing, initially focused on coding agents like Claude Code.

items.title: Jacquard — Programming language designed for AI-written, human-reviewed code
items.summary: Programming language for AI-generated code with visible effects in function signatures, content-addressed definitions, and the Warp testing framework with replay and handler substitution.

items.title: OpenAI researcher Miles Wang in talks to launch AI drug discovery startup valued at $2B
items.summary: Roughly $200M at a $2B valuation with Lightspeed in discussions to lead. The startup would focus on AI models for drug repurposing and discovery, with multiple OpenAI researchers expected to join.

items.title: Hadrius raises $27M for AI-powered compliance infrastructure for financial services
items.summary: AI-native compliance platform automating workflows for 500+ financial institutions raised $27M in a combined seed and Series A round led by CRV with Y Combinator and Pathlight Ventures.

items.title: Hinge founder raises $18M for AI dating service Overtone
items.summary: Voice- and audio-forward AI dating service providing curated introductions raised $18M in seed funding backed by Match Group, FirstMark Capital, and Pace Capital.
